title: On a noncommutative deformation of holomorphic line bundles on complex tori and the SYZ transform
summary: By regarding a given $n$-dimensional complex torus $X^n$ as the trivial torus fibration $X^n \to \mathbb{R}^n/\mathbb{Z}^n$, we can obtain a mirror dual complexified symplectic torus $\check{X}^n$ based on the SYZ construction. In the middle 2000s, as a part of the study on noncommutative deformations of $X^n$, Kajiura examined the noncommutative complex torus $X_θ^n$ obtained via the (real) nonformal deformation quantization of $X^n \to \mathbb{R}^n/\mathbb{Z}^n$ by a Poisson bivector $θ$ defined along the fibers.
